questions.question: What is the average of all natural numbers from 21 to 39?
questions.solution:
This sum is the sum of an AP with first term a = 21 and difference d = 1

Let n be the total numbers in the AP

Sum of AP = n/2[first term + last term]

⇒ Sum of AP = n/2[21 + 39]

Average = Sum of AP/total numbers

⇒ Average = [(n/2)(60)]/n

∴ Average = 30

questions.question: A farmer buys a goat and a sheep for Rs. 3500. He sold the sheep at a profit of 20 percent and the goat at a loss of 10 percent. If he sold both the animals at the same price, then the cost price (in Rs) of the cheaper animal was?
questions.solution:
Given: CP of both animals = Rs. 3500 and SP of both the animals are same

Let the CP of goat be Rs g and CP of sheep be Rs. s

⇒ g + s = 3500 ----(i)

⇒ g(1 + 20/100) = s(1 - 10/100)

⇒ 1.2g = 0.9s

⇒ g = 3s/4 ----(ii)

Substituting (ii) in (i)

⇒ 3s/4 + s = 3500

⇒ 7s/4 = 3500

⇒ s = (3500 × 4)/7 = 2000

⇒ g = 3s/4 = 1500

So, g < s

questions.question: What is the HCF of 6345 and 2160?
questions.solution:
Prime factorization of 6345 = 3 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 47

Prime factorization of 2160 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 3 × 5

So, the common factors = 3 × 3 × 3 × 5 = 135

questions.question: Δ DEF is right angled at E. If ∠D = 30°, what is the length of DE (in cm), if EF = 6√3 cm?
questions.solution:
Given: ΔDEF is right angled at E and ∠D = 30°

We know that tanθ = Perpendicular/base

⇒ tan∠D = EF/DE

⇒ tan30° = 6√3/DE

⇒ 1/√3 = 6√3/DE

⇒ DE = 18 cm

questions.question: In an MBA selection process, the ratio of selected to unselected was 11 : 2. If 40 less had applied and 20 less selected, the ratio of selected to unselected would have been 10 : 1. How many candidates had applied for the process?
questions.solution:
Let the total number of candidates be a

The number of candidates that were selected = 11a/13

The number of candidates that were not selected = 2a/13

When 40 less candidates apply, the number becomes a - 40

When 20 less candidates are selected, the number of selected candidates becomes (11a/13) - 20

Unselected students in new scenario = (a - 40) - [(11a/13) - 20]

New ratio becomes = (11a/13) - 20/{(a - 40) - [(11a/13) - 20]} = 10

⇒ (11a/13) - 20 = 10{(a - 40) - [(11a/13) - 20]}

⇒ 11a/13 - 20 = 10[2a/13 - 20]

⇒ 11a/13 - 20 = 20a/13 - 200

⇒ 9a/13 = 180

Multiplying above equation by 13/9

∴ a = 260

questions.question: What is the circumference (in cm) of a circle whose area is 616 sq cm?
questions.solution:
Let r be the radius of the circle

Given: Area of circle = 616 cm²

⇒ 22/7 × r² = 616

⇒ r² = 196

⇒ r = 14 cm

So, the circumference of circle = 2 × (22/7) × 14 = 88 cm

questions.question: At what rate of compound interest (in %) per annum will a sum of Rs. 15,000 become Rs. 18,150 in 2 years?
questions.solution:

⇒ 1.21 = (1 + r/100)²

Taking square root on both sides

⇒ 1.1 = 1 + r/100

∴ r = 10

questions.question: If a + b = 4 and ab = -21, then what is the value of a³ + b³?
questions.solution:
Given: a + b = 4 and ab = -21

We know that: (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

⇒ 4³ = a³ + b³ + 3(-21)(4)

⇒ 64 = a³ + b³ - 252

∴ a³ + b³ = 252 + 64 = 316

questions.question: Two cars A and B travel from one city to another, at speeds of 35 km/hr and 45 km/hr respectively. If car B takes 2 hours lesser time than car A for the journey, then the distance (in kms) between the two cities is?
questions.solution:
Let the time taken by A to cover the distance be t and the total distance be a km

⇒ 35t = a ----(i)

⇒ 45(t - 2) = a ----(ii)

Equating (i) and (ii), we get

⇒ 35t = 45(t - 2)

⇒ 35t = 45t - 90

⇒ 10t = 90

⇒ t = 9

Putting t = 9 in (i)

⇒ 35 × 9 = a

∴ a = 315

A can do a work in 24 days and B in 40 days. If they work on it together for 10 days, then what fraction of work is left?
questions.solution:
Let the total work be a

Work done by A in 1 day = a/24

Work done by B in 1 day = a/40

Work done by both in 1 day = a/24 + a/40 = a/15

Work done by both in 10 days = 10(a/15) = 10a/15 = 2a/3

∴ Required fraction = (2a/3)/a = 1 - (2/3) = 1/3

questions.question: If Sinθ = 20/29, then what is the value of SecθSinθ?
questions.solution:
We know that sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

⇒ (20/29)² + cos²θ = 1

⇒ cos²θ = 1 - 400/841

⇒ cos²θ = 441/841

Doing square root

⇒ cosθ = 21/29

∴ Required value = SecθSinθ = (1/cosθ)sinθ = (29/21)(20/29) = 20/21

questions.question: Two numbers are 10% and 20% lesser than a third number respectively. By how much percent is the second number should be enhanced to make it equal to the first number?
questions.solution:
Let the third number be a

So, the first number = a(1 - 10/100) = 0.9a

Second number = a(1 - 20/100) = 0.8a

Let the enhancement % be b

⇒ 0.9a = 0.8a + 0.8a × (b/100)

⇒ 0.1a = 0.8a × (b/100)

⇒ 0.1 = 0.8b/100

⇒ b = 100/8 = 12.5

questions.question: If 9x - [5(2x + 1)/2] = 9/2, then the value of x is?
questions.solution:
Given: 9x - [5(2x + 1)/2] = 9/2

Multiplying above equation by 2

⇒ 18x - 5(2x + 1) = 9

⇒ 18x - 10x -5 = 9

⇒ 8x = 9 + 5

∴ x = 14/8 = 7/4

questions.question: The sum of a fraction and 10 times its reciprocal is 37/4. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be a

⇒ a + 10(1/a) = 37/4

⇒ a + 10/a = 37/4

⇒ a² + 10 = 37a/4

⇒ a² - 37a/4 + 10 = 0

Multiplying above equation by 4

⇒ 4a² - 37a + 40 = 0

⇒ 4a² - 32a - 5a + 40 = 0

⇒ 4a(a - 8) -5(a - 8) = 0

⇒ (4a - 5)(a - 8) = 0

∴ a = 5/4, 8

The 2nd and 6th term of an arithmetic progression are 8 and 20 respectively. What is the 20th term?
questions.solution:
Let the first term of A.P. be a and let the difference be d

⇒ a + d = 8 ----(i)

⇒ a + 5d = 20 ----(ii)

Subtracting (i) from (ii)

⇒ 4d = 20 - 8 = 12

⇒ d = 3

Putting the value of d in (i)

⇒ a + 3 = 8

⇒ a = 8 - 3 = 5

So, 20th term = a + 19d = 5 + 19 × (3) = 5 + 57 = 62

questions.question: What is the equation of a line which has 3 as x-intercept and -5 as y-intercept?
questions.solution:
Given: x-intercept = 3; y-intercept = -5

The line passes through (3, 0) and (0, -5)

⇒ y = [(y₂ - y₁)/(x₂ - x₁)]x - 5

⇒ y = [(-5)/(-3)]x - 5

⇒ y = 5x/3 - 5

Multiplying above equation by 3

⇒ 3y = 5x - 15

⇒ 5x - 3y = 15

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (3, 2) in the line y = -2?
questions.solution:
To find: reflection of the point (3 , 2) in the line y = -2

The equation of line is: y + 2 = 0

The formula for finding the image of a point (x₁,y₁) to the line ax + by + c = 0 is given by:

(x - x₁)/a = (y - y₁)/b = - 2(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²)

Here, a = 0, b = 1 and c = 2

So, we have

(y - 2)/(1) = -2(2 + 2)/(1) and (x - 3) = 0

⇒ y - 2 = -8 and x = 3

⇒ y = -6 and x = 3
